name: tunnel
description: 把本机的 SHE 服务通过隧道暴露到公网，手机或另一台电脑就能打开同一个界面。不内建任何隧道实现，而是调用你已安装的工具（cloudflared / ngrok / tailscale），所以链路和账号都由你自己掌握。
author: SHE built-in

tools.name: tunnel_providers
tools.description: Detect which tunnel CLIs are installed on this machine (cloudflared, ngrok, tailscale) and show the exact command SHE would run.

tools.name: tunnel_start
tools.description: Start a tunnel to the local SHE server using one of the detected providers. Returns the public URL once it appears in the provider's output.

seconds.description: How long to wait for the URL (default 25)

tools.name: tunnel_stop
tools.description: Stop the tunnel this plugin started so the public URL stops working.

commands.title: 检测隧道工具
commands.description: 看看机器上有没有 cloudflared / ngrok / tailscale
